fields.description: Issue features prominent local reporting on a municipal court crackdown on illegal gambling devices (marble boards, dice machines) and related racketeering, including a subpoena involving Bill Frey and actions by city officials. It also covers the disappearance of George F. McCall, Clerk of Criminal Court, discussing alleged office shortages and his business interests. Additional content includes editorials and advertisements promoting keeping faith with the NRA, columns on racing and sports (including commentary on the Braddock–Baer fight), and local society/entertainment notes and advertising.
